descriptor.name: NDGISHUB Parcels (State Parcel Program) — statewide
descriptor.licenceNote: Source conditions are informational; users choose their source and intended use.
descriptor.operator: North Dakota Information Technology / ND GIS Hub State Parcel Program; county parcel data
descriptor.scope: North Dakota State Parcel Program compilation, all 53 counties. UniqueGISID is the program's statewide key: five-digit county FIPS, a dash and the county GISID.
caveats: The layer includes right-of-way, water and unknown feature types alongside parcels; FeatureType is null in some counties (e.g. Cass), so no type filter is applied and such polygons appear with their own UniqueGISID.
Rows with null or blank UniqueGISID (38,250 statewide on 2026-10-12) are excluded; 486 values carry leading or trailing spaces and are kept verbatim.
Same endpoint as us-nd-burleigh-bismarck-parcels (CountyName=Burleigh, key GISID under US-ND-BURLEIGH-); Burleigh County parcels would exist under both namespaces.
descriptor.attribution: North Dakota GIS Hub State Parcel Program and North Dakota counties. Adapted to WGS84.

jurisdiction.basis: ND GIS Hub State Parcel Program item aggregates county parcel boundaries statewide; all 53 counties present on 2026-10-12.

evidence: ND GIS Hub State Parcel Program item aggregates county parcel boundaries statewide; all 53 counties present on 2026-10-12.
